title: Quick No-Rise Pizza
subtitle: ready in half an hour
description: A soft real yeast dough that puffs up as it bakes, with no proving beforehand.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to its maximum temperature (about 250°C).
Mix the water, honey, oil, yeast and salt in a mixer with a dough hook.
Gradually add the flour while kneading until you have a soft, smooth dough that pulls away from the sides of the bowl. Keep kneading for another 3-5 minutes.
Oil the dough, wait 10 minutes, then shape: stretch it into one large round or two small ones.
Spread the dough with tomato sauce and sprinkle with cheese and toppings of your choice.
Bake the pizza for 8-10 minutes and serve immediately.
